text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Hm? Hey, isn't that—

text_block_list.name: Mysterious Girl
text_block_list.text: Ah! It's you again!

text_block_list.name: Mysterious Girl
text_block_list.text: The Golden Knight… Wait, I guess you're actually a time traveler? Oh, whatever! I'm so glad to see you again, Miss Golshi!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Well, if it ain't the ace from Galaxy M76's Space Federation!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Has Earth's fate been decided? Personally, I'd rather you guys wait a bit longer before turning us into space dust.

text_block_list.name: Mysterious Girl
text_block_list.text: Hehe! Fear not! Your desperate plea moved the hearts of the council so much, they decided to delay the demolition of Earth indefinitely!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Ahaha! That's what I like to hear! Looks like I've saved the world yet again!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's the little "princess" we once met in the park.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's endearing seeing how in sync the two of them are.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Hey, what's that you've got there?

text_block_list.name: Mysterious Girl
text_block_list.text: Oh, it's just my notebook. You see…

text_block_list.name: Mysterious Girl
text_block_list.text: I like thinking about "what-ifs." Like, what if the world was different? Or what if I was a different kind of person? Things like that.

text_block_list.name: Mysterious Girl
text_block_list.text: Up until now, I've only daydreamed alone… But you inspired me to jump headfirst into brand new worlds.

text_block_list.name: Mysterious Girl
text_block_list.text: Thanks to you, I've come up with so many more ideas! And I've started writing them all down!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Her notebook is packed with exciting stories and worlds that have me hooked just after a few lines.

text_block_list.name: Mysterious Girl
text_block_list.text: One day, I'm going to give shape to these ideas! I don't know yet if it'll be a manga, or a movie, or a book… but I'll find a way to share them with everyone!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Hnnngh… You… you…

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: You're sooo awesome! That's about the awesome-est thing I've ever heard!

text_block_list.name: Mysterious Girl
text_block_list.text: Ehehe! Once it's done, you'll be the first one I tell!

text_block_list.name: Mysterious Girl
text_block_list.text: So look forward to it!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Heh. The sun's setting on another day…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The girl runs off with a wave, and Gold Ship watches her until she disappears into the distance…
choice_data_list: I can't wait to see what she makes.

Now I want to make something too.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Haha, I feel you! Maybe we can have a cameo if she makes a movie.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: I bet we'd be a perfect fit for the characters she wrote about on the first page.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: It's our origin story. She's the princess, I'm the Golden Knight, and you're my pinky finger.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: She's on a quest to restore the decimated Argent Kingdom to its former glory.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: The journey is full of trials and tribulations, but the pinky improves in leaps and bounds until it can fire beams of light from both hands…

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Hey! What's with that pathetic look?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: You gotta persevere until the awesome ending! Bahaha!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Hmm… Hate to say it, but that might be a bit tough.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Why? Have you completely forgotten?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: VZHWOOOM!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Suddenly, something enormous appears, fills the sky, and releases a blinding light!

text_block_list.name: Suspicious Man A
text_block_list.text: Good grief! We finally have you, Young Miss!

text_block_list.name: Suspicious Man B
text_block_list.text: It's time for you to study. Come now, let's return… to our planet!

text_block_list.name: Mysterious Girl
text_block_list.text: Fiiine… But you know… Hehe! I had a wonderful time here!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Vwoosh…

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: …Heh. Off she goes.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Gold Ship and I watch as the speck disappears into the twilit sky…

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Oho? What's this? Am I witnessing the birth of yet another delightful writer?!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Very well! Ahem! I, the great literary master Golgol, shall lend you my ears.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Speak your ideas at will!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As prompted, I use my imagination to spin a tale on the spot.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Hmmm… Interesting.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Superb, absolutely superb! That was the very definition of genius!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: But it would be even more perfect if a torrent of grape gummies fell from the sky at the very beginning!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Yes, then the forest should begin writhing as the moon transforms into a regular heptacontadihedron…

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: But all these anomalies are only the tip of the iceberg!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Not much is left of the story I envisioned by the time Gold Ship is done with it, but we have a fulfilling creative discussion nonetheless.
